topic: the ASCII UART animator skill: sending framed ASCII animations to a UART device over the rock1 shell bridge

subtopics.scope: The bridge execution model: Python renders per-frame ASCII, wraps each frame in a printf write to /dev/ttyS2, bundles all frames plus sleep pacing into one bash script, and POSTs it to the rock1 Tailscale-Funnel shell bridge where user shant runs it.
seed_queries: Tailscale Funnel expose local service public internet
Linux ttyS0 serial port device write terminal ttyS

subtopics.scope: Invoking the scripts: run_script with the rock1 shell bridge connection passed, self-contained per-animation Python scripts, or inline render_frame logic in a run_script call.
The five built-ins (bouncing_ball, bouncing_ball_ansi, fish_swim, walking_man, play_all) and the Built-in animations table of frames, FPS and scenes that is the calibration source of truth.
Clear-and-redraw versus scroll: the ESC[H ESC[2J escape pair, the bash printf %b directive that turns repr()'s newline escapes into real newlines, and why %s would print them literally.
seed_queries: ANSI escape codes cursor home clear screen ESC[2J VT100
bash printf %b backslash escape sequences versus %s

subtopics.scope: The knobs (W, TOTAL_FRAMES, FPS_DELAY) and the wire-interval model: actual frame interval is FPS_DELAY plus bytes_per_frame/baud_rate, with 115200 8N1 arithmetic (a 200-byte frame adds about 17 ms).
seed_queries: UART 115200 baud throughput bytes per second calculation
serial port 8N1 start stop bits framing overhead per byte

subtopics.scope: The extension recipe: write render_frame(n, total) returning a newline-joined string, loop frames into the printf+sleep bash script, POST via post_to_bridge.
Operational quirks: the bridge runs subprocess.run(argv) with no shell interpolation so quoting lives inside the bash -c string; multi-thousand-line scripts take 20+ seconds wall clock.

The UART testing discipline: measured calibration values (wire-interval floor, demonstrated 30 fps ceiling, bridge latency bound), the false-positive check for rendered-but-frozen playback, and verifying scripts against the frame table.
seed_queries: serial console testing tips stty screen minicom UART debugging
embedded UART transmit timing baud rate frame transmission time

subtopics.scope: Coverage sections and self-audit: the 2026-09-17 unsupported-claims removal precedent, connection-churn checks before every play, table-vs-scripts audits, re-run triggers, and the Guidelines scope boundary.
